official_measurement_examples.name: Annual landlord check
official_measurement_examples.fact: HSE states landlords must arrange a gas safety check every year for each appliance and flue they own and provide for tenants.

official_measurement_examples.name: Gas Safe engineer
official_measurement_examples.fact: HSE states landlord gas maintenance and safety checks must be carried out by a Gas Safe registered engineer competent for the relevant work category.

official_measurement_examples.name: Record to tenant
official_measurement_examples.fact: GOV.UK states landlords must provide a gas safety record before move-in or within 28 days of the check for existing tenants.

official_measurement_examples.name: Twelve-month validity
official_measurement_examples.fact: HSE states a gas safety record is valid for twelve months from the date of the check, subject to the detailed rules.

official_measurement_examples.name: New appliance flexibility
official_measurement_examples.fact: HSE describes limited one-off timing flexibility under the 2018 amendment for aligning a new appliance's first check with existing annual checks.

official_measurement_examples.name: Tenant-owned appliance
official_measurement_examples.fact: HSE distinguishes tenant-owned appliances from appliances the landlord owns and provides, while landlord pipework duties can still remain relevant.

official_measurement_examples.name: No appliance caveat
official_measurement_examples.fact: HSE states where there are no gas appliances in the property, pipework or a flue passing through alone does not create the same annual appliance-check requirement.

official_measurement_examples.name: Planning separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Gas safety duties, Gas Safe registration and landlord records do not themselves grant planning permission or prove network capacity.

core_rules: annual gas safety check is not planning permission
planning permission is not gas safety compliance
Gas Safe registration is not proof of a specific installation
engineer competence category must match the actual work
gas safety record is not a Building Regulations completion certificate
twelve-month record period is not a planning permission duration
landlord-owned appliance duty must not be generalized to tenant-owned appliances
tenant-owned appliance does not remove all landlord pipework duties
no gas appliance is not proof no gas infrastructure exists
Gas Safe registration does not reserve gas network capacity
gas appliance safety check is not a utility connection offer
2018 timing flexibility is not a waiver of annual safety duties
historic gas safety record must retain its check date
gas safety compliance does not create ownership or access rights
no parcel gas-safety clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
